text:
So small, the sweet marjoram,

and... how it smells!

So small.


At night, beneath the morning star,

so small, the sweet marjoram,

and how it smells!


And... when it rains in the afternoon,

how it smells!


And when the sun rises,

so small, the sweet marjoram,

how it smells!


And now, as I live from dream,

how it smells,

so small, the sweet marjoram!


How it hurts!...

so small, the sweet marjoram.

So small.

translation.title: Corner of Blood
translation.editorial_note: The translation renders 'almoraduj' as sweet marjoram and keeps the refrain's turn from scent to pain.
